_about: Well-known events whose Wikidata item carries no date, so the Wikidata passes cannot place them. Dates written for GeoHistory from general knowledge; they stay "curated, unverified" until Wikidata has a date to compare with.
period: Events without a date on Wikidata

events.label: Federation of Australia
events.desc: The six British colonies in Australia unite as the Commonwealth of Australia.

events.label: Trail of Tears
events.desc: After the Indian Removal Act of 1830 the United States forces the Cherokee, Muscogee, Seminole, Chickasaw and Choctaw nations west of the Mississippi; the Cherokee removal of 1838 gives the name.

events.label: Castle Bravo
events.desc: The United States tests its largest hydrogen bomb at Bikini Atoll; fallout contaminates nearby atolls and a Japanese fishing boat.
